LanguageData.SD_Intro: Your machines – mechanoids (vanilla, DLC and modded), androids (Vanilla Races Expanded – Android) and other robot races. Combat mechs guard the base and the whole map, every machine gets looked after.
LanguageData.SD_SetGuardTip: Machines in "Guard" mode patrol the edge of the home area, its outer doors and the most valuable rooms, a share of them sweeps the whole map. When enemies come close, the nearest ones intercept them and the rest hold the side of the base the enemies come from. Afterwards they go back to their posts. Drafted machines always obey you.
LanguageData.SD_SetAutoGuardTip: Mechs without any work (militors, scythers, centipedes …) stand guard on their own. Work mechs keep working. Each machine can be switched with its mode button.
LanguageData.SD_SetSweep: Guards that sweep the whole map: {0} %
LanguageData.SD_SetRadius: Enemies this close to the base wake the guard: {0} cells
LanguageData.SD_SetRooms: Guard the two most valuable rooms too
LanguageData.SD_SetRoomsTip: A post inside the richest rooms of the home area (storerooms, throne room …).
LanguageData.SD_SetStagger: Guards recharge one at a time
LanguageData.SD_SetStaggerTip: While one guard is charging, the others wait (unless one is nearly empty), so the base is never left without its guard.
LanguageData.SD_SetRecharge: A guard goes to recharge below: {0} % energy
LanguageData.SD_SetRetreat: Badly damaged machines leave the fight
LanguageData.SD_SetRetreatTip: A guard below this health goes to the far side of the base instead of fighting.
LanguageData.SD_SetRepairTip: The mechanitor then repairs them on his own. You can switch it off again on the mech.
LanguageData.SD_SetSchedule: Droids that never sleep work around the clock
LanguageData.SD_SetScheduleTip: Androids and robots without a need for sleep get "work" for all 24 hours – once; your own later changes stay.
LanguageData.SD_SetFireTip: In every Steward plan droids get firefighting on priority 1. With two or more of them, people are one step lower for fires.
LanguageData.SD_SetWarnTip: A warning when a mech is nearly empty and no charger is free, an android's reactor is nearly spent, or neutroamine runs low.
LanguageData.SD_ModeDesc_Auto: combat mechs guard, the rest work
LanguageData.SD_ModeDesc_Guard: patrol the base and the map, fight intruders
LanguageData.SD_ModeDesc_Work: left to its work as usual
LanguageData.SD_ModeDesc_Rest: mechs go to a charger now
LanguageData.SD_StPausedMode: guard paused – the mech is in mode "{0}"
LanguageData.SD_StHold: holding the side of the base under attack
LanguageData.SD_WarnMechEnergy: {0} is nearly out of energy and no charger is free.
LanguageData.SD_WarnReactor: {0}: the reactor is nearly spent – it needs replacing.
LanguageData.SD_TabInfo: Guard posts on this map: {0}. Click a name to find the machine, click the mode to change it.
LanguageData.SD_Advice: Nobody in the colony is good at: {0}. An android with a subroutine for it would help.
